definitions.explanation: The central administrative office of a prefecture, and by extension the prefectural government as an organization.

examples.japanese: {県庁|けんちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勤|つと}めている→勤める：00902_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: I work at the prefectural government office.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{県庁|けんちょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can do that procedure at the prefectural office.

examples.japanese: {県庁|けんちょう}⟦{所在地|しょざいち}→所在地：15409_shozaichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{限|かぎ}らない→限る：02033_kagiru⟧。
examples.english: The city where the prefectural office is located is not necessarily the most populous city in the prefecture.

notes:
The administrative headquarters of a ⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧ (prefecture). Can refer to the building itself or to the prefectural government as an organization.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {県庁|けんちょう}⟦{所在地|しょざいち}→所在地：15409_shozaichi⟧: the prefectural capital (city where the office sits)
- {県庁|けんちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勤|つと}める→勤める：00902_tsutomeru⟧: to work at the prefectural office
- {県庁|けんちょう}{前|まえ}: in front of the prefectural office (a common place name)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{市役所|しやくしょ}→市役所：03067_shiyakusho⟧: city hall — the equivalent office at the municipal level
- {都庁|とちょう}: Tokyo Metropolitan Government office — the equivalent for {東京都|とうきょうと}
